scope: Adaptive ideal-oracle continuation with unrestricted even/odd weights and explicit rejection checks.
normalized_bound: E/|sample| + ((T-1)/N0)^q for nonempty sample and N0; E=sum_i max(sizes(i+1),2).
requirements: Ideal independent uniform challenges and query seeds with replacement.
Prefix-causal snapshots include current oracle, accumulated measure, even/odd weights and sent quadratic.
No initial functional candidate is the reduction premise, not a verifier test.
limits: Causality remains a theorem premise; executable prefix strategy still needs instantiation.
Accepted transcripts do not deterministically imply a candidate; failure probability is explicitly bounded.
No Merkle-root extraction, rate-shift domain/OOD transfer or QROM argument.
This does not change the four-query diagnostic into a secure protocol.
